review_flags.text: Seems my wild days are past

lines.text: There was a time when I flew higher
Was a time the wild girl running free
Now I see her, feel the fire
Now I know she needs me there to share
All these blank and tranquil years
Seems they've dried up all my tears
And while she runs free and fast
Seems my wild days are past
I miss the highs and lows
All the climbing, all the falling
All the while the wild wind blows
My feet are on the ground
And cuts you like a knife

editor_notes: This draft uses singing-specific word starts as timing anchors.
Line starts come from the first word in each lyric line.
Line ends are inferred from the next line start, not from word endings.
Lines with long held notes or suspiciously short timings are flagged for review.
This is an editable draft, not a final export.
